output.reason: The linked issue and PR [ev-42fa75fce2bf][ev-8f88a1c550c9] describe the exposure condition: running `argocd cluster add` with `--cluster-endpoint kube-public` when the certificate_authority_data in the kubeconfig differs from the one in kube-public. They also describe the old behaviour: the CLI took the endpoint from kube-public but the CA from the kubeconfig. The reproduction in [ev-df926eb00efd] shows the consequence: an x509/TLS "certificate signed by unknown authority" error, so the cluster add fails. The fix touches only the CLI cluster code [ev-c19adf9bd20f] and makes it use the kube-public CA instead, so in 3.0.0 those additions succeed and nothing else is affected.
